name: blueprint-helper
description: Codex-facing BlueprintHelper workflow plugin for Unreal Editor asset reads and TaskSpec-first writes through the BlueprintHelper CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Use BlueprintHelper CLI from Codex for UE asset workflows.
interface.longDescription: BlueprintHelper guides Codex through Unreal Editor asset reads and TaskSpec-first Blueprint, UMG, DataAsset, DataTable, compile, save, open, and diagnostics workflows. The Codex plugin exposes the CLI-first workflow and intentionally does not register the deprecated MCP endpoint as a normal Agent entry.
defaultPrompt: Inspect a Blueprint with BlueprintHelper CLI
Preview a TaskSpec before executing an edit
